item.title: BotOps
item.description: A Call Of Duty Zombies-inspired Robot shooter, where I was primarily responsible for the Enemy Wave System and Player Progression, as well as animation-handling and gunplay, as well as a Sub-Level system allowing our leveldesigners to stitch together multiple scenes.
